name: Eoalligator
isnote: PBDB places it in the Orientalosuchina, a group the atlas has no clade for.
sum: Eoalligator is an alligatoroid crocodilian known from fragmentary remains from the Paleocene of Guangdong, China.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Fragmentary material from Nanxiong County, Guangdong, described by Young (1964); catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Material from three localities within 8 km of each other in Nanxiong County.
biology: The sources consulted give no direct evidence of diet or habits.
author: Young 1964
